title: Standout styling and prestige cues
summary: This topic centers on descriptions of the vehicle standing out visually through styling, design, prestige, and elegance, but most sampled fragments do not state a clear sentiment.

positive.summary: The positive review praises the car’s styling for clearly standing out.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention the vehicle standing out through visual design, prestige, equipment, power, or comparison language without enough context to confirm sentiment.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are assigned undetermined sentiment, so the emotional direction of this topic is unclear.
Several fragments are very short or lack context, which limits confidence about whether mentions of prestige, elegance, or standing out are favorable evaluations.
Some examples reference comparisons or adjacent attributes like drivability, cabin, or equipment rather than a single tightly defined styling theme.
